claims.assertion: Yazhi says Viera's traffic-control data showed no unusual nonhuman craft activity during the reported shootdowns.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says routine drone traffic continued.

claims.assertion: Yazhi speculates that a staged alien-invasion narrative could unite humanity and justify digital identifiers, but says she does not predict it will happen.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as one of several possible agendas.
